title: Eyes
spec: Swim to the light and touch it.
author: @Cy-3LO

say: Swim to the light and touch it. To see it, the swimmer needs an **Eye**.
Press the **Board** button or tab, or press Tab.
An **Eye** sends beads as fast as it sees light: more from a light near it and in front of it.
Here the light is straight ahead.
Put an **Eye** and a **Thruster** on the board, both pointing forward, and wire the **Eye** to the **Thruster**. Then run it.
